audit: TerraEcho FIRMS public country archive acquisition
authentication: None; public HTTPS requests only. No MAP_KEY, Earthdata login, token or credential used.
download_policy: Only nonempty CSVs with the exact expected schema and valid numeric/time/date/platform fields are saved to data/raw. Source bytes remain unchanged.

product.archive_family: VIIRS Suomi-NPP 375 m yearly country archive

limitations: Acquisition date range describes detections, not independently verified satellite observation coverage.
